name: adbase
description: Competitor ad research: track the Facebook, Instagram and Google ads, landing pages and email newsletters of the brands you compete with, and analyze their creatives, hooks, angles and offers.

interface.longDescription:
AdBase is a competitor ad library and ad spy tool for ChatGPT. Add the brands you compete with and AdBase keeps collecting their Meta ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google ads, the landing pages those ads point to, and the email newsletters they send. Ask ChatGPT what your competitors are running and get answers grounded in the real ads.

What you can ask:
- "What ads are my competitors running on Facebook and Instagram right now?"
- "Which of their ads have been running the longest?"
- "Break down the hook, script and CTA of this video ad, scene by scene"
- "Find UGC and founder-to-camera ads with a free-shipping offer from beauty brands"
- "Compare their landing pages and offers side by side"
- "What did they promote in their newsletters this month?"
- "Turn the best angles into a creative brief and five new hooks for our next ad test"

Every ad is tagged by creative style (UGC talking head, founder to camera, studio product, lifestyle, meme, text graphic, review card, comparison), angle (problem-solution, social proof, outcome and benefit, authority, comparison, urgency, value/price) and offer (percent discount, free shipping, free trial, bundle, subscribe and save, guarantee), so ChatGPT can filter thousands of ads to the ones that matter. Video ads come with a spoken transcript, a visual transcript with on-screen text, and contact sheets, so ChatGPT can read a video ad like a script. Meta ads include EU transparency data such as reach and targeting.

Built for ecommerce and DTC brands, creative strategists, media buyers, performance marketers and agencies doing competitor analysis, ad creative research and swipe files. Track up to 25 advertisers per workspace. Ads, landing pages and emails can also be shown as visual cards in the chat.

Requires an AdBase account at getadbase.com.
capabilities: Track competitors' Facebook and Instagram ads
Search competitor ads by keyword, platform, format, status, creative style, angle and offer
Find competitors' longest-running and newest ads
Break down video ads: hook, spoken transcript, on-screen text and CTA, scene by scene
Read and compare competitor landing pages with screenshots
Read competitors' email newsletters, offers and subject lines
See what changed: new ads, stopped ads and new landing pages
Show ads, landing pages and emails as visual cards
defaultPrompt: What ads are my competitors running on Facebook and Instagram right now?
Break down the hooks and scripts of my competitors' longest-running video ads
Compare my competitors' landing pages, offers and newsletters this month

positive.description: See which competitors the workspace tracks.
positive.prompt: Which competitors am I tracking in AdBase?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the brands on the reviewer workspace's watchlist with their status (for example watching or discovering).

positive.description: Find and show a competitor's current Meta ads.
positive.prompt: What ads are my competitors running on Facebook and Instagram right now? Show me the five most interesting ones.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches active Meta ads across the watched brands, summarizes the creatives, copy and offers, then shows five ads as a carousel of ad cards.

positive.description: Break down a video ad scene by scene.
positive.prompt: Find my competitors' newest video ad and break down its hook, script and call to action.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the newest video ad, then describes the hook in the first seconds, the spoken script, the on-screen text per scene and the CTA, based on the ad's transcripts and contact sheets.

positive.description: Analyze and show a competitor's landing pages.
positive.prompt: Compare the landing pages my competitors send their ads to and show them to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the captured landing pages, compares their offers, headlines and structure, and shows them as screenshot cards with a desktop/mobile toggle.

positive.prompt: What did my competitors send in their email newsletters recently? Show me the best ones.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent captured emails with subjects, send dates and offers, summarizes the email strategy, and shows selected emails as rendered mail cards.

negative.description: General writing or translation with no competitor ad research intent.
negative.prompt: Translate "Thanks for your order, it ships tomorrow!" into Spanish, French and German.

negative.description: AdBase does not generate images or video.
negative.prompt: Generate a product photo of my water bottle on a beach for an Instagram ad.

negative.description: Unrelated request with no ad research intent.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Amsterdam tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: AdBase does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Its tools read competitor ad research data and manage the user's own watchlist.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: competitor ad library with Meta and Google ads, video ad breakdowns, landing pages and email newsletters.
